comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
The main legacy discovery from the middle / center section of legacy from "Ancient City of Halicarnassus" legacy theme. You will get the "Widow's Cup" upon visiting. You also get nicely 650 Sophia from discover this.

Here, you can search by digging the yellow pillar spot, hoping you might be able to snatch the good items. Then there is an exit once you done.

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
All things you can get from here:

Ancient Iron Meteorite
Petasos
Himation
Ancient City's Laurel Wreath
Hermes' Sandals
Sailors' Old Compass

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: The 5*SW to get the clue "Sunken Ship and the Statue of Goddess" can be shared for all in fleet, meaning that when the ship emerges from the waters all fleet member will get the clue

comments.author: Morro
comments.body: As a less interesting side note, you can get Rocks, White Ore, Red Ore, Green Ore, Marble and Iron Ore from Collection. Rocks from Procurement.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A word of caution concerning the Legacy zones: if you disconnect or log out in them, you will log back in to find yourself in the normal landing zone with the following message: "The power from the Book of Wisdom faded and you returned back to the original place."

This will happen only if you enter the Legacy zone and make the discovery. This is only a bother to those who plan to farm the 10 light pillars, of course... or who were hoping they could stay there for a while. *cough* Cheers.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Note about the Shipwreck: You gain the Legacy clue for raising shipwrecks in the East Mediterranean if the wreck is 5* or higher. It doesn't only have to be 5*, just in case there was any confusion about that.

Additionally, there is a formula to the items you locate with Search skill. It is as follows:

R1-5: Ancient Iron Meteorite
R6-9: Old Sailor's Compass / Oak Wine Barrel
R10-14: Ancient City's Laurel Wreath, Petasos | Herodotus | Ancient Civilization Decor 2
R15: Hermes Sandals, Himation | Deep Sea Red Pine Plating

So the higher your rank is, the more items are likely to drop from the above table. Cheers, and good luck with your item drops.
